name: Quattroporte V
description: The fifth-generation Quattroporte (2003–2012), designed by Pininfarina and engineered with Ferrari's assistance, was a landmark in luxury performance saloons. Its Ferrari-derived 4.2-litre V8 and longitudinal gearbox mounted at the rear axle gave perfect 50:50 weight distribution. It re-established Maserati as a genuine Ferrari alternative.
